default.$description: Cards, panels and anything that sits on the page.

brand.$description: The main button: the one thing to press first.

brand-hover.$description: The main button under the pointer.

brand-subtle.$description: Tags and soft highlights in the brand colour.

success.$description: A solid success badge, such as Paid. Status colours are the same in every brand.

success-subtle.$description: The soft fill behind a success notice.

warning.$description: A solid warning badge, such as Due soon. A light yellow, so the text on it is dark (color.text.on-warning).

warning-subtle.$description: The soft fill behind a warning notice.

critical.$description: A solid critical badge, such as Failed.

critical-subtle.$description: The soft fill behind a critical notice.

info.$description: A solid info badge, such as New.

info-subtle.$description: The soft fill behind an info notice.

brand.$description: Text on a subtle brand fill.

success.$description: Text on the soft success fill (color.fill.success-subtle).

on-success.$description: Text on the solid success fill (color.fill.success).

warning.$description: Text on the soft warning fill (color.fill.warning-subtle).

on-warning.$description: Text on the solid warning fill (color.fill.warning): dark, since that fill is a light yellow.

critical.$description: Text on the soft critical fill (color.fill.critical-subtle).

on-critical.$description: Text on the solid critical fill (color.fill.critical).

info.$description: Text on the soft info fill (color.fill.info-subtle).

on-info.$description: Text on the solid info fill (color.fill.info).

success.$description: The edge of a success notice.

warning.$description: The edge of a warning notice.

critical.$description: The edge of a critical notice.

info.$description: The edge of an info notice.
